amendments.plan_version_decision: Bumped to research-plan-2026-09-14-v3. Plan-version continuity between predecessor and successor receipts is not enforced. receipts.py _check_predecessors (lines 553-638) requires TASK_GRAPH dependencies, matching SHA-256 digests and recursive verification; it never reads a plan_version field. identity.py RECEIPT_KEYS (lines 29-44) and validate_receipt_shape (lines 172-194) bind plan_sha256 and predecessor digest maps, not a plan version string. receipts.py _check_identities (lines 1188-1190) recomputes this receipt's plan_sha256 from PLAN_SNAPSHOT.files only. Therefore a plan-file amendment does not require predecessor receipts to share the successor's plan version string.
